title: Using The Featured Blog Article Slider With Other Post Types
text:
## Using The Featured Blog Article Slider With Other Post Types
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000066244
The admin can use the "Featured Blog Article Slider" add-on functionality to show single photo posts such as blogs (Default), articles, coupons, and Jobs.
If the admin would like to use this add-on with any of the posts mentioned above, please follow these steps:
1. Go to Settings - Design Settings and click on Home tab, from there expand the Select Content to Display:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090967606/original/OZMLd5ne9MAFk5ShHWJL0Uer1s372L88tg.png?1617736055 | alt: ]
2. Select the option "Featured Blog Article Slider"
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090967673/original/exS9aBdx7TKuZAmKCfCk_sREbHXWBQaWIw.png?1617736166 | alt: ]
3. Choose the post type the admin wants to use this streaming widget with: articles, coupons, or jobs . In this case, I'll use the coupons post type, so I'll choose "Coupons".
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090967790/original/xqGtiWlKcMVed5Pz90uAH8g0PaFQaBuepw.png?1617736346 | alt: ]
4. By default, the Blog Form has a field to display the "Featured Post Input", so in order to add these new posts, we need to add this same field to the coupons form. Please go to Toolbox >> Form Manager.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090967837/original/KxjtxzjSIXBRllR23yVidj68RA8Q1Wk_uw.png?1617736417 | alt: ]
5. Find the form the admin needs to customize (Articles, coupons, or jobs).
6. Click on Actions >> Customize.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090967872/original/LKHDInfiLCTDMEv0xEMLDG1FFR1Eky4srA.png?1617736473 | alt: ]
I'm going to customize the "Coupons" form because I'm using this post type as an example but if the admin is going to use another post, please use the following forms:
Articles: member_article_fields
Coupons: coupon_fields
Jobs: job_fields
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090967903/original/IJTk1tR4m_fFcuhJSSfMDj0DP2O4Hl5mOg.png?1617736512 | alt: ]
7. Click on "New Field".
8 Select "Custom HTML" as the Field Type.
9. In the"Field Label" option, paste this widget: [widget=Bootstrap Theme - Display - Feature Post Input]
10. In the "Database Variable" field, paste this variable: widget_bootstrap_theme_display_feature_post_input
11. Show in Display View? need to be set to "Off".
12. Show in Input View? need to be set to "On".
13. Save the changes.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090968053/original/qerSa4Zy0ELHNXn6zZRVs3ySoPZO4ardqg.png?1617736761 | alt: ]
Once this has been added the admin will see a new field in the "Coupons" form. It will allow the admin to select the posts they want to show in the homepage slider.
Before the form customization:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090968291/original/6rIHbNAtLwBbl6lB7B2Lu_PJ7eS3bWzOIA.png?1617737077 | alt: ]
After the form customization:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090968317/original/89IH456R2sjFgk9jEcpiEa6yIaOwlgQffA.png?1617737115 | alt: ]
Now, when a coupon is added, we can select which coupon to show in the homepage slider.
They will look like this:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12072372888/original/QhDudF0enlJT1GOOx5mFzcmbTlbgBnMLpA.gif?1579032265 | alt: ]
Important: this add-on won't work with multiple photo posts such as properties, photo albums, classifieds, products, etc. Also, make sure to follow the suggested image size: Recommended image size 760x400 pixels
Note: This could also work for other post types like the Events Post type, but to have this working , it will be required to do some small customizations to the widget: Bootstrap Theme - Homepage - Featured Blog Posts Slider. This "<" sign has to be changed for a ">" sign, flipping the way the logic works in relation to the start_date of the posts:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12116679235/original/OYqh2_uspQsQuH-tUO5SHH7unu_9i4oYQA.jpeg?1667320652 | alt: ]
If this add-on is not yet owned, the admin can purchase it on our website . Also find more information about this add-on in our documentation: Featured Blog Article Slider Add-On .
